reason: The campaign exposed evaluator defects: the gate ignored adjudicated evidence in evidenceRejected, treated file-level citations promised by the baseline contract as insufficient, leaked Challenger citation failures into a metric documented as proposal-only, imposed hidden field-location and lexical requirements, and included a retry case outside its visible freshness window.
